title: Ops Soundcheck: release cadence and observability cues
content:
Summary:

This is a lightweight 'soundcheck' notebook for the next sprint release (target week of 2026-05-17). The purpose: create a short, operator-friendly preflight, hourly cadence, and an observability matrix that frontloads signal checks before and during traffic shifts. Treat this as the canonical quick-run for on-call and release shepherds — minimal reading, clear handoffs, and explicit telemetry thresholds.

Quick context / goals:
- Release type: patch + small feature flags (no DB migrations).
- Primary risk vectors: latency regressions on small payloads, token-queue backlog under burst load, rare OOMs on quantized models.
- Soft SLOs for this release: p50 latency <= 60ms for hosted-api small-gen path; error rate < 0.3% across routes.

High-level schedule (soundcheck cadence):
- T-72h (2026-05-14): Telemetry dry-run + smoke harness. Owners: Aisha, Liam.
- T-48h (2026-05-15): Canary build pushed to staging infra; start 2h smoke window. Owner: release-engineering lead.
- T-24h (2026-05-16): Canary to 1% traffic; full trace sampling for canary. Ops soundcheck #1 (see checklist).
- T-0 (2026-05-17 10:00PT): Gradual ramp to 25% over 2 hours if all gates pass. Ops soundcheck #2.
- T+6h: Evaluate residuals and escalate if >1 warning threshold breached.
- T+24h: Post-rollout review and notes update.

Ops soundcheck checklist (concise):
1) Build & artifact checks
   - Verify artifact SHA in release ticket (REL-2315) matches CI output.
   - Confirm pinned model-weights version and quantization profile.

2) Pre-deploy telemetry sanity
   - Launch synthetic load for 15m against canary: check p50/p95 for small-gen and chat routes.
   - Confirm KV cache hit rate baseline; expect >= 72% for interactive samples.

3) Observability matrix (what to watch, owner, threshold)
   - Route: hosted-api/small-gen | Owner: Liam | Alert if p50 > 80ms OR error rate > 0.4%
   - Route: chat-stream | Owner: Sofia | Alert if stream dropouts > 0.2% of sessions
   - Model-serving GPU memory | Owner: Ravi | Warning if used > 85% on any node
   - Request queue length | Owner: SRE on-call | Critical if > 200 requests queued per node for > 2m
   - KV cache eviction spikes | Owner: Aisha | Alert if eviction rate > 3x baseline

4) Canary behavior expectations
   - Latency should stay within 10% of staging smoke-run baseline.
   - Token generation distribution should not shift (no new high-latency tails).
   - No new error class > 0.1% incidence (e.g., rate-limiter gapping, OOMs).

5) Communication & fallbacks
   - Slack channel: #release-soundcheck (pinned: REL-2315, PR#987, on-call roster).
   - Escalation ladder: release engineer -> eng-sre -> infra lead (Ravi).
   - Fallback plan: pinned older model variant (model-v1.8) and reduced batch size profile.

6) Post-deploy checks (T+1h, T+6h, T+24h)
   - T+1h: confirm error rate and p95 across all model-backed routes.
   - T+6h: run lightweight eval prompts from REL-2315 to surface quality regressions.
   - T+24h: roll-forward note with summary metrics and any action items for next sprint.

Operational quick-run (operators):
- Preflight (10–20m): run the synthetic harness (scripts/tools/synth-smoke.sh) with the canary artifact; post results to #release-soundcheck.
- Initiate canary: trigger rollout job with tag 'soundcheck-2026-05' and set sampling to 1%.
- Watch first 10 minutes: keep p50/p95 charts and error counts visible. If any matrix threshold tripped, immediately pause rollout and follow RCA path.

Unresolved questions / notes to triage:
- Is there a scheduled maintenance window for downstream infra (cache cluster) on 2026-05-16 afternoon? (asked Slack #infra).
- Should we temporarily disable the new batching heuristic for dedicated pools during the canary? (Ravi to advise).

Release notes draft (short blurb for release log):
- Patch: model-serving runtime bump (inference-kernel v2.3.1) with optimized kv-cache prefetch for small sequences; flag-gated batching heuristics.
- Notes: No DB schema changes. Rolling rollout will be gradual; rollback to model-v1.8 if memory pressure observed.

Attachments / commands (quick):
- CI artifact check: ./scripts/check-artifact-sha.sh REL-2315
- Synthetic smoke: ./scripts/synth-smoke.sh --target canary --duration 900
- Rollout trigger: ./scripts/trigger-rollout.sh --tag soundcheck-2026-05 --percent 1

Appendix: short-run playbook if p95 jumps but p50 OK
- Immediately reduce canary traffic to 0% while leaving observability running.
- Capture heap profile and recent logs for failing nodes (SRE runbook link: CONFLUENCE-LOG-HEAP).
- If memory/growth suspected, roll back to pinned model variant and open incident ticket.

Notes to self (Aisha):
- Keep the soundcheck checklist < 1 page. Operators ignore >1 page preflight.
- Try to capture one 'success metric' for the post-roll digest (e.g., cost delta, median latency shift).

If anything unexpected: call Ravi (infra lead) and mark the release ticket with 'hold:observability'.

-- end of draft --
